name: Виграш пішака (3)
description: Winning a pawn can often make a decisive difference. Sometimes you must settle for a small gain, and in this lesson, you will repeatedly have opportunities to capture a pawn.

examples.text: The black queen is overloaded. After the rook exchange, Black is forced to give up the defense of the c-pawn.

examples.pgn: 1... Qb6+ {[%csl Rb2,Gb6,Rg1][%cal Gb6b2,Gb6g1]} 2. Kh1 Qxb2 {[%csl Gb2]} *

texts: Pawn gain is a nice step toward victory.
